<b>{{PAGENAME}}</b> is a consumable product, able to restore a relatively small amount of health and a moderate amount of energy. It can be brewed at varying quality levels using a [[brewing stand]], or purchased from (or sold to {{Quality|Copper}} or {{Quality|Silver}}only) the barkeeper [[Horadric]]. The quality of the crafts depend on the quality of the [[hops]] used.

==Quest==
===Get Gerry Beer===
[[Gerry]] requests beer which requires you to find [[Horadric]] in the [[village]] at the [[The Dead Horse|tavern]].  You can buy a beer or use the beer you earned as a reward for delivering [[Blacksmith]]'s letter.

===[[Inquisitor|Snack Time]]===
The [[Inquisitor]] asks that you build a buffet tent and sell food and drink for the witch burning. You will need to make {{Item|Burger|5|Gold}} and {{Item|A mug of beer|10|Gold}}.

To make the tent will need: {{Item|Hemp rope|5}}, {{Item|Wooden plank|15}} and {{Item|Nails|20}}.

After completing the quest, the player has the opportunity to refill the tent with {{Item|Burger|5|Gold}} and {{Item|A mug of beer|10|Gold}} to open the buffet for profit every {{Day|Wrath}}.

==Trading==
With the DLC ''[[Stranger sins|Stranger Sins]]'', mugs of beer - as with most beverages - may be sold regularly, either passively by being stored in the [[Talking Skull]]s cellar, or actively by being stored in the [[Barman]]s inventory and triggering an event.
